tasks.label: Normalize continued spell strings
args: $files = Get-ChildItem -Path 'spells\default' -Recurse -Filter '*.json5'; foreach ($file in $files) { $lines = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllLines($file.FullName); $previousContinued = $false; $updated = foreach ($line in $lines) { if ($previousContinued) { $line = $line -replace '^\s+', '' }; $previousContinued = $line.TrimEnd().EndsWith('\'); $line }; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines($file.FullName, $updated, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)) }
